notes: Shopify storefront (Milton, Indian houseware/kitchenware brand). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (User-agent: * Allow: /); accessed via HTTP-first tier only (curl + Shopify collections.json + rendered PLP HTML), no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed. Discovery method: (1) fetched full /collections.json (288 collections across 2 pages, confirmed page 3 empty = complete set), scanned every title for seasonal/festival/occasion keywords; (2) fetched header mega-menu and the /pages/gifting-page hub to see how gift/occasion categories are surfaced in real navigation; (3) fetched each candidate collection's rendered PLP HTML directly and read the live 'id="ProductCount"' status element for the true displayed total (Shopify's collections.json products_count field is known-inflated per prior-batch findings, so it was not used for qty). No Hindi/local-language nav or site version exists (single English-language site) so no additional multilingual discovery was needed. No parent 'Diwali'/'Christmas'/'Valentine's Day' root grouping PLP exists anywhere on the site (confirmed absent from the collection list) - each holiday's sub-collections are flat leaf PLPs, so category is used as the holiday label with no is_group rows. Milton is pure kitchenware/houseware (bottles, cookware, tiffins, jars) so Christmas/Diwali/etc. show up ONLY as curated GIFTING collections (e.g. 'Diwali Gifting', 'Christmas Gifts'), never as decor/ornament/lighting categories - genuinely absent, not overlooked (checked full title list, no Christmas Decor/Tree/Ornaments/Lighting, no Diwali Decor/Diyas-branded/Lanterns, no Halloween or Easter or Thanksgiving anywhere in the 288-collection catalog). EXCLUDED as non-seasonal (universal/undated personal-occasion gifting, not calendar holidays): Anniversary Gifts, Anniversary Gifts For Him, Birthday Gifts For Men, Birthday Return Gifts, Bulk Gift Buying Products, Corporate Gifting & Bulk Order, Corporate Gifting (Milton Concepts), Gifts For Men, Gifts for Students, House Warming Gifts, Wedding Gifts, Wedding Gifts for Groom, Wedding Presents for Bride, Wedding Return Gifts, Marriage Gifts for Friends. EXCLUDED as generic discount/marketing campaign pages (fail the PLP-vs-marketing test, matches the rules' explicit 'X Sale' exclusion pattern): Black Friday Sale, Onam Sale (title/H1 literally 'Onam Sale', meta description is templated SEO copy identical in style to Black Friday Sale/Republic Day Sale, and its top-ranked products are the same sitewide bestseller set that leads every '*-sale' collection - judged a discount campaign despite Onam being a genuine festival; logged to qa_notes.md as a borderline call), Republic Day Sale, GST Savings Festival 2025, Clearance Sale, Wedding Season Sale (H1 'Wedding Season Sale', meta description is generic storewide-discount copy about kettles/cookware/bottles, not curated wedding gifting), Raksha Bandhan Sale (handle 'on-sale', generic storewide-discount description - the genuine curated Rakhi PLP is 'Raksha Bandhan (Rakhi) Gifts', which IS included). EXCLUDED duplicate: 'Secret Santa Gifts' (619 products) resolves to virtually the same underlying listing as 'Christmas Gifts for Employees' (619 products, 13/15 identical top products in identical order) - kept 'Christmas Gifts for Employees' (explicit Christmas naming) per the shared-listing overlap rule, dropped Secret Santa as the redundant node. EXCLUDED: 'Diyas' (generic product-type collection, name does not tie it to Diwali, and live PLP shows only 1 product - not a meaningful category either way); 'Serendipity Arts Festival' (a brand-sponsorship merch tie-in to a real Goa arts festival, not a consumer holiday/seasonal shopping occasion - same species as the site's other brand-collab collections like 'Marvel Collection' / 'Milton x Chennai Super Kings', not a Christmas/Diwali-style holiday). INCLUDED, per explicit task instruction, Mother's Day and Father's Day under the same genuine-PLP test as any other holiday (both have dedicated, real, non-sale-branded gifting PLPs). Also included Teachers Day, Children's Day, Women's Day, and Friendship Day Gifts on the same reasoning as Mother's/Father's Day: each is a fixed annual calendar occasion (not a personal/undated occasion like birthday/anniversary) with its own dedicated, non-'Sale'-branded gifting PLP and real displayed qty - flagged in qa_notes.md as a borderline extension of the Mother's/Father's Day precedent for cross-session consistency. Valentine's Day has one general PLP plus six audience-segmented PLPs (Boyfriend/Girlfriend/Her/Him/Husband/Wife); spot-checked handle overlap - counts differ across all seven (389/546/610/419/559/407/765) and while 'Him' and 'Boyfriend' share their top 20 products in the same order, their live totals differ (559 vs 546), so they are not identical-facet duplicates; kept all seven as the site's own genuine audience-segmented taxonomy rather than dropping any. Diwali has three distinct, only-partially-overlapping curated PLPs (Diwali Gifting / Corporate Diwali Gifting / Diwali Gift For Boss, spot-checked at 20-60% mutual overlap, different displayed counts) - kept all three as genuine sub-categories, none is an exact duplicate of another.
